entities.summary: Ricardo Augusto Amaral Acioly is a former tennis player from Brazil. He has what is considered by many one of the most complete and successful careers in Brazilian tennis, having been recognized Internationally as a player, coach, executive, tournament promoter, and sports commentator. Ricardo Acioly was a athletes & competitors from Rio de Janeiro (b. 1964-02-04, Rio de Janeiro). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
